title: Loading into a staging table with upserts

objectives.text: Open a psycopg connection from an environment-variable connection string in a with block, then load parsed records into a staging table in batches with executemany or COPY instead of one statement per row
Write an INSERT ... ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE upsert keyed on a unique constraint and predict the table after the same load runs twice
Explain why the load is made idempotent so a failed or repeated run leaves no duplicate rows
